node.constraint: Export default React component `CommentSection` accepting `comments` (array of {id,author,avatar?,body,time,replies?}) with a composer box + reply support. Tailwind only.

[DEFAULT STYLE] Threaded list: top composer (avatar + textarea + "Comment" Button indigo), then comments indented by depth (replies pl-8 border-l border-slate-100). Each comment: avatar + author font-medium + time text-xs text-slate-400 + body, hover "Reply" link that opens an inline composer. Like button optional. Smooth, neutral palette.
Export default React component `Feed` accepting `posts` (array of {author,avatar?,time,text,image?,likes,comments}) rendering an infinite-scroll-style timeline. Tailwind only.

[DEFAULT STYLE] Single centered column max-w-xl of post Cards: header (avatar + author + time + ⋯ menu), body text, optional image (rounded-xl), footer action row (like ♥ with count, comment, share) with hover states. Composer pinned at top. Generous spacing, light bg, like animation on tap.

Export default React component `ProfilePage` accepting `user` ({name,handle,avatar,bio,cover?,stats:{posts,followers,following},isFollowing}) with follow/edit button + tabs (Posts/Media/Likes). Tailwind only.

[DEFAULT STYLE] Cover banner (h-40 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-purple-500) with overlapping avatar (rounded-full ring-4 ring-white -mt-12 w-24). Name font-bold text-xl + @handle + bio. Stat row (Posts/Followers/Following counts). Primary action button ("Follow" indigo / "Following" outline / "Edit profile"). Below: Tabs switching content panels. Responsive, centered container.
Export default React component `Chat` accepting `peer` ({name,avatar,online?}), `messages` ({from,body,time,status?}), `onSend`, `typing?`. 1:1 realtime-style DM. Tailwind only.

[DEFAULT STYLE] Floating (or full) panel: header with Avatar + name + online dot + actions, scrollable bubble thread (mine indigo right, theirs white left, ticks for read), typing indicator (three bouncing dots), composer (TextField + send, optional attach). Smooth entrance. Powers DMs & support chat.
Export default React component `Stories` accepting `stories` ({id,user,avatar,seen?}), `onOpen`. Horizontal reel of circular previews opening a viewer. Tailwind only.

[DEFAULT STYLE] Horizontal scroll row of w-16 circles (ring-2 gradient ring-indigo-500 to-fuchsia-500 when unread, slate when seen) with name under; click opens a full-screen viewer (progress bars at top, tap left/right to navigate, X to close). Instagram/Snapchat-style.
Export default React component `NotificationFeed` accepting `items` ({actor,avatar?,verb,target,time,read?,type?}) as a full page (distinct from the Notification dropdown). Tailwind only.

[DEFAULT STYLE] Page list of notification rows: Avatar + "Actor verb target" (actor bold, unread bg-indigo-50 + dot), relative time, type icon (like=rose, follow=indigo, comment=slate). "Mark all read" + filter tabs (All/Unread/Mentions). Dense, scannable, like X/LinkedIn notifications.
